sentences.en: This book is too large to go in my pocket.
sentences.zh: 这本书太大了，放不进我的口袋。

sentences.en: This hamster is small enough to carry in your pocket.
sentences.zh: 这只仓鼠很小，可以揣在兜里带着。

sentences.en: A boy was walking with his hands in his pockets.
sentences.zh: 那个男孩把手插在裤兜里走着。

senses.zh: 小型的，袖珍的；金钱上的
